extras: macOS only; requires Obsidian 1.13.7+; menu/command labels are in Korean.
intentEvidence: Open a Markdown file in Typora directly from Obsidian's file context menu or command palette.
problem: Users who wish to view or edit Markdown files using Typora while working within Obsidian need a simple way to trigger this external application.

relations.evidence: Open a Markdown file in Typora directly from Obsidian's file context menu or command palette.

summary: Opens Markdown files directly in Typora from the Obsidian file context menu or command palette on macOS.
